question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"Dissection of a dead body to find the cause of death."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Autopsy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Autopsy"** refers to the examination of a dead body to determine the cause of death or the extent of disease. (शव परीक्षण)
 
 
• **Example:** The autopsy revealed that the cause of death was a heart attack.
 
 
• It is a medical procedure performed by forensic pathologists to investigate suspicious or unknown causes of death.

**Correct word explanation:** The word "Autopsy" (शव परीक्षण) is derived from the Greek word "autopsia," meaning "to see with one's own eyes." It is commonly used in forensic investigations.

 
• **Example:** An autopsy was conducted to confirm whether the death was due to natural causes or foul play.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Autopsy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Biopsy** (जैवोपरीक्षण): A medical test involving the removal of tissue to examine it for disease, usually cancer.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor performed a biopsy to check for signs of cancer in the tissue.
 
 

 
• **Surgery** (शल्य चिकित्सा): A medical procedure involving the manual or instrumental treatment of a patient to treat diseases or injuries.
 
 
• **Example:** The patient underwent surgery to repair a fractured bone.
 
 

 
• **Anatomy** (शरीर रचना): The study of the structure of the human or animal body.
 
 
• **Example:** Students of medicine must study anatomy to understand the human body's structure.
